info.title: Maitri Ceramic ERP API Documentation
info.description:
Enterprise API specifications for Maitri Ceramic Customer, Billing & Inventory Management System.

Developed by **NexAlliance** for **Piyush Bhai (Maitri Ceramic)**.

post.summary: Create a new quotation with line item snapshots & server-computed amounts
post.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION.create`. Generates atomic sequential quotation number and freezes product snapshots.

productId.description: Product Master ID (optional for SKU-less items)

adHocName.description: Required if productId is not provided

adHocMrp.description: Required if productId is not provided

get.summary: Get list of pending quotations for review and follow-up
get.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION.view`. Returns active quotations not in terminal states.

get.summary: Convenience product picker: Get products by Company Master ID
get.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION.view`. Filters products for brand-specific quotation building.

200.description: List of products belonging to company

get.summary: Get complete quotation details with populated customer, salesperson & company

put.summary: Update quotation header or line items (Permitted in DRAFT/SENT status only)
put.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION.edit`. Blocked if status is CONFIRMED or CLOSED. Recomputes amounts server-side.

put.summary: Mark quotation as SENT to customer (DRAFT -> SENT)

put.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION.delete`. Preserves historical record across customer 360 and product tracking.

get.summary: Render quotation in any of the 8 formats on demand
get.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION.view`. Transforms canonical document into requested presentation format.

get.summary: Download quotation in any format as Excel (.xlsx) or PDF

post.summary: Log a new follow-up and drive quotation status
post.description: Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.create`. Atomically records follow-up log and updates Quotation.status to resultingStatus.

201.description: Follow-up logged and quotation status updated successfully

400.description: Validation failed or invalid resultingStatus for Module 6

get.summary: List all follow-up entries with filtering & pagination
get.description: Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.view`. Filtered by user dataScope (ALL, OWN, TEAM).
Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.view`. Computes server-side alerts: 1. No follow-up yet, 2. Overdue follow-up, 3. Due today follow-up, 4. Expiring soon quotations, 5. No customer response.

200.description: Computed 5 alert categories and summary count

get.summary: Export filtered follow-up records to Excel (.xlsx)
Get chronological follow-up timeline for one Quotation
get.description: Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.view`. Returns all active follow-up entries newest-first.

get.summary: Get single follow-up details by ID

put.description: Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.edit`. If resultingStatus is modified, Quotation.status is updated ONLY IF this record is the most recent active follow-up.

delete.description: Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.delete`. Soft-deletes the record; does not auto-revert quotation status.

put.description: Requires permission `FOLLOW_UP.delete`. Soft-deletes the record; does not auto-revert quotation status.

post.summary: Create a new quotation confirmation (Quoted -> Confirmed -> Extra)
post.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION_CONFIRMATION.create`. If the user holds `approve`, it transitions Quotation.status to CONFIRMED or PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED. Otherwise, it sits in `pendingApproval: true`.

400.description: Validation failed or active confirmation already exists

get.summary: List quotation confirmations with pagination & filter

put.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION_CONFIRMATION.edit`. Allowed ONLY if zero material has been delivered yet (`deliveredQuantity === 0` on all items).
Requires permission `QUOTATION_CONFIRMATION.approve`. Finalizes pending confirmation and updates Quotation.status to CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED.

200.description: Confirmation approved and quotation status updated

put.summary: Cancel confirmation (Reverts quotation status to CUSTOMER_INTERESTED)
put.description: Requires permission `QUOTATION_CONFIRMATION.delete`. Allowed ONLY pre-delivery; soft-cancels confirmation and returns quotation to follow-up stage.

get.summary: 4-Stage Quantity Ledger per item (Quoted -> Confirmed -> Extra -> Delivered)
Quotation Amount vs Actual Amount Comparison Breakdown
Export confirmation and quantity ledger to Excel (.xlsx)

post.summary: Manual Stock In Entry (Opening Stock, Purchase Entry, Manual Addition, Other)
post.description: Requires permission `STOCK.create`. Atomically updates `Product.currentStock` cache and appends immutable ledger entry with running `balanceAfter`.

post.summary: Manual Stock Out Entry (Manual Deduction, Other)
post.description: Requires permission `STOCK.delete`. If reason is `MANUAL_DEDUCTION`, also requires `STOCK.approve`. Rejects negative balance by default unless `allowNegative: true`.

get.summary: List Stock Ledger Entries with filter & pagination
get.description: Requires permission `STOCK.view`. Supports filters: productId, reason, direction (IN/OUT), from, to, page, limit.

get.summary: Low Stock Report (Products where currentStock <= reorderAlertQty)
get.description: Requires permission `STOCK.view`. Filters all products currently at or below their configured reorder threshold.

get.summary: Purchase Alert Engine (Shortfall vs Confirmed Quotations)
get.description: Requires permission `STOCK.view`. Identifies products where Available Stock (Actual - Management Stock) < 0 to prompt immediate procurement.

200.description: Calculated purchase alerts and shortfall quantities

get.summary: Export Stock Reports (Movement History / Low Stock / Purchase Alerts) to Excel (.xlsx)
Stock Summary for a Product (Actual Stock, Management Stock, Available Stock)
get.description: Requires permission `STOCK.view`. Computes Actual Stock (Product.currentStock cache), Management Stock (live from Module 7 confirmed pending deliveries), and Available Stock (Actual - Management).

200.description: Detailed stock figures and availability indicators

get.summary: Stock Movement History (Ledger) for a single product
get.description: Requires permission `STOCK.view`. Chronological append-only ledger entries with exact running `balanceAfter`.

post.summary: Reconcile Product Stock Cache against Ledger Entries (Admin Safety Net)
post.description: Requires permission `STOCK.approve`. Recalculates total sum of all ledger entries from scratch, corrects any drift on `Product.currentStock`, and logs audit metadata.

post.summary: Create a new DRAFT Challan against an active Quotation Confirmation
post.description: Requires permission `CHALLAN.create`. Validates quantities against live pending-delivery data. Creates Challan in `DRAFT` status without deducting stock or modifying delivery totals.

get.summary: List Challans with filters, pagination and dataScope
get.description: Requires permission `CHALLAN.view`. Filters: customerId, confirmationId, quotationId, status (DRAFT/FINALIZED/CANCELLED), from, to, search.

get.summary: Get single Challan details by ID

put.summary: Update DRAFT Challan (Allowed ONLY while status is DRAFT)
put.description: Requires permission `CHALLAN.edit`. Rejects edits once Challan is FINALIZED.

put.summary: Cancel DRAFT Challan (Allowed ONLY while status is DRAFT)
put.description: Requires permission `CHALLAN.delete`. Rejects cancellation once Challan is FINALIZED.

put.summary: Finalize Challan (ATOMIC DUAL-WRITE: stock deduction + delivery recording)
put.description: Requires permission `CHALLAN.approve`. Executes a single database transaction: deducts physical stock (Module 8) and records delivered quantity (Module 7). On success, locks Challan into immutable FINALIZED status.

200.description: Challan finalized and stock deducted atomically

get.summary: Get formatted delivery note print data
Discover FINALIZED un-invoiced Challans eligible for billing
get.description: Requires permission `INVOICE.view`. Returns FINALIZED, active Challans where `invoiced: false`. Filters: `customerId`, `confirmationId`, `search`.

post.summary: Generate customer Tax Invoice from one or more Challans
post.description: Requires permission `INVOICE.create`. Validates all Challans are FINALIZED and belong to the same customer, resolves pricing from Confirmation items, server-computes all amounts/GST, creates Invoice, and marks source Challans as `invoiced: true`.

get.summary: List Invoices with filtering and pagination

get.description: Requires permission `INVOICE.export`. Generates downloadable Excel workbook.

200.description: Invoice details with line item breakdown

put.description: Requires permission `INVOICE.edit`. Modifies non-monetary header fields only. Any attempt to modify items, quantities, rates, or totals is stripped by middleware.

put.summary: Cancel Invoice and reopen source Challans
put.description: Requires permission `INVOICE.delete`. Soft cancels the invoice (`status: CANCELLED`) if zero payments exist, and resets source Challans to `invoiced: false` so they can be re-invoiced.

200.description: Invoice cancelled and source challans reopened successfully

get.summary: Get live balance due and payment summary for an invoice
get.description: Requires permission `INVOICE.view`. Calculates total invoice amount, total payments allocated, and remaining balance due.

get.summary: Get render-ready tax invoice printable dataset

200.description: Complete tax invoice printable structure with company letterhead, tax breakdown, and amount in words

post.summary: Record customer payment with multi-invoice allocation
post.description: Requires permission `PAYMENT.create`. Validates that sum of allocated amounts equals total amount, all invoices belong to the customer, and allocation does not exceed live balance due. Auto-generates receipt number.

201.description: Payment recorded and receipt generated successfully

get.summary: List payment collections with filtering and pagination
Get live Customer-level outstanding financial summary
get.description: Requires permission `PAYMENT.view`. Aggregates `totalInvoiced`, `totalPaid`, and `totalOutstanding` live across all customer invoices.

get.summary: Get live Balance Due for a specific invoice

get.description: Requires permission `PAYMENT.export`. Generates downloadable Excel workbook.

get.summary: Get detailed Payment record by ID

200.description: Payment record details with multi-invoice allocation breakdown

put.summary: Update non-monetary metadata of a Payment
put.description: Requires permission `PAYMENT.edit`. Updates non-monetary fields only (`referenceNumber`, `bankCashAccount`, `remarks`). Total amount and allocations are strictly immutable.

post.summary: Reverse a Payment (Double Gate: delete + approve)
post.description: Requires BOTH `PAYMENT.delete` AND `PAYMENT.approve` permissions. Creates an offsetting `REVERSAL` record while preserving the original row, restoring invoice balance due.

201.description: Payment reversed and reversal record generated

200.description: Payment receipt dataset with company letterhead, allocated invoices, and amount in words

post.summary: Log Purchase Return (DRAFT)
post.description: Creates a Purchase Return Note in DRAFT status with zero stock impact. Stock deduction occurs upon confirmation.

201.description: Purchase Return logged in DRAFT status

post.summary: Log Sales Return (DRAFT)
post.description: Creates a Sales Return Note in DRAFT status with optional Invoice/Challan lineage. Zero stock impact until confirmed.

remarks.example: Tile boxes unopened and in good condition

201.description: Sales Return logged in DRAFT status

200.description: Return Note details with populated references

put.summary: Update Return Note (Non-stock fields if CONFIRMED)

put.description: Gated by `RETURN_NOTE:approve`. Executes `stockService.deductStock()` for Purchase Return or `stockService.addStock()` for Sales Return. Locks record against further edits.

200.description: Return Note confirmed and stock movement posted

get.summary: Get chronological running-balance ledger for a customer
get.description: Requires permission `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.view`. Returns Tally-style chronological ledger with Running Balance, Debit, Credit, and Source references.

get.summary: Get fast current outstanding balance for a customer
get.description: Requires permission `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.view`. Returns the most recent running balance without recalculating from history.

get.summary: Get render-ready printable customer statement for date period
get.description: Requires permission `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.view`. Includes period Opening Balance, individual transactions with running tally, and Closing Balance.

post.summary: Post a manual Credit / Debit adjustment entry
post.description: Requires dual permissions: `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.create` AND `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.approve`. Supports opening balance migration, write-offs, and custom accounting adjustments.

post.summary: Reverse a previously posted manual ledger entry
post.description: Requires dual permissions: `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.delete` AND `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.approve`. ONLY permitted for `sourceType: MANUAL`. Automated entries must be corrected via their source module.

200.description: Manual entry reversed with offsetting MANUAL_REVERSAL record

get.summary: Export customer statement or Credit/Debit report to Excel (.xlsx)
get.description: Requires permission `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.export`. Downloads formatted Excel statement with Opening and Closing balances.

get.summary: Get Quotation Usage and demand history for a specific Product
get.description: Requires `PRODUCT_QUOTATION_TRACKING.view`. Aggregates all quotation items matching this product, joins confirmation quantities, and computes summary figures.

200.description: Product quotation demand, confirmed comparison, and usage list

get.summary: Get Ranked Most Quoted Products in a given period
get.description: Requires `PRODUCT_QUOTATION_TRACKING.view`. Returns top products ranked by quotation count and total quoted demand value.

200.description: Ranked list of most quoted products

get.summary: Get Distinct Customers quoted a specific Product
get.description: Requires `PRODUCT_QUOTATION_TRACKING.view`. Returns distinct customer profiles with total quoted volume and value for this product.

200.description: List of distinct customers quoted this product

post.summary: Force recompute of ProductQuotationSummaryCache for a product
post.description: Requires `PRODUCT_QUOTATION_TRACKING.view`. Rebuilds cached summary totals from live quotation data.

get.summary: Export Product-Quotation Tracking reports to Excel (.xlsx)
get.description: Requires `PRODUCT_QUOTATION_TRACKING.export`. Generates styled Excel spreadsheet for product usage, ranking, or quoted customers.

get.summary: Get dynamic report catalog annotated with user permissions
get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view`. Returns all 5 report categories and individual reports annotated with whether the requesting user has access based on underlying module permissions.

200.description: Report catalog tree with access flags

get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view`. Returns preset filter combinations created by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Save a report filter configuration

delete.summary: Delete a user saved report filter
delete.description: Requires `REPORTS.view`. Can only delete filters created by the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get status of an async report export job
get.description: Requires `REPORTS.export`. Polls async generation progress for high-volume export requests.

200.description: Export job status and download path

get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view` AND `CUSTOMER.view`. Lists all customers with balance due and summary totals.
Requires `REPORTS.view` AND `CUSTOMER.view`. Focuses on product purchasing patterns.

200.description: Customer ledger statement with running balances

get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view` AND `QUOTATION.view`. Filters active quotations awaiting confirmation.

200.description: Quotations due for follow-up today or overdue

get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view` AND `QUOTATION.view`. Computes conversion rate by count and value.

get.summary: Quotation Amount vs Actual Amount Comparison Report
get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view`, `QUOTATION.view`, AND `QUOTATION_CONFIRMATION.view`. Lists quoted vs confirmed amounts.

200.description: List of customers quoted a specific product
Products ranked by total quoted value
Products with stock at or below reorder level
Management stock balances net of reservations
Stock movement history across date ranges
Invoices register report with grand totals

get.description: Requires `REPORTS.view` AND `PAYMENT.view`. Surfaces the customer outstanding report in the financial section.
Requires `REPORTS.view` AND `CUSTOMER_LEDGER.view`. Consolidated debit vs credit ledger view.

200.description: Credit and Debit totals and line items

get.description: Requires permission `AUDIT_LOG.view`. Returns append-only activity log records filtered by user, module, action type, entity, and date range.

parameters.name: moduleKey
parameters.description: Filter by SystemModule key (e.g. QUOTATION, INVOICE)

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Filter by entity type (e.g. Quotation, Invoice, Customer)

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Filter by specific entity document ObjectId

get.summary: Export activity logs as formatted Excel spreadsheet
get.description: Requires permission `AUDIT_LOG.export`. Streams downloadable .xlsx workbook matching query filters.

get.summary: Get chronological activity timeline for a specific entity document
get.description: Requires permission `AUDIT_LOG.view`. Returns full chronological lifecycle history for one document (e.g. Quotation #Q-2026-27-0042).

get.summary: Get chronological activity timeline for a specific user
get.description: Requires permission `AUDIT_LOG.view`. Returns all actions performed by this user across all system modules.

get.summary: Get single activity log entry detail with full change diff
get.description: Requires permission `AUDIT_LOG.view`. Returns detailed log entry including changeSummary before/after diff.
